definitions.explanation: A phone call that includes live video feed, allowing participants to see each other in real time.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}にいる{家族|かぞく}とビデオ{通話|つうわ}をする。
examples.english: I make video calls with my family overseas.

examples.japanese: ビデオ{通話|つうわ}で{顔|かお}を{見|み}ながら{話|はな}せる。
examples.english: With video calls, you can talk while seeing each other's faces.

examples.japanese: スマホでビデオ{通話|つうわ}をかける。
examples.english: I make a video call on my smartphone.

notes:
ビデオ{通話|つうわ} refers to a phone or internet call with live video, allowing participants to see each other in real time. It covers calls on smartphones, tablets, and computers using apps like LINE, FaceTime, or Zoom.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ビデオ{通話|つうわ}をする: to make a video call
- ビデオ{通話|つうわ}をかける: to place a video call
- ビデオ{通話|つうわ}に{出|で}る: to answer a video call

CONTRAST:
- ビデオ{通話|つうわ}: personal one-on-one or small group calls
- ビデオ{会議|かいぎ}/オンライン{会議|かいぎ}: formal, business-oriented meetings
- テレビ{電話|でんわ}: video phone (older term, less common now)

RELATED TERMS:
- {音声|おんせい}{通話|つうわ}: voice call (audio only)
- {画面|がめん}{共有|きょうゆう}: screen sharing
